ja322:1.1: duddubhāyati → daddabhāyati (bj) | daddabhāyati → dadadubhāyati (bj: machasaṁ) | Duddubhāyati → daddabhāyati (cck: sī. pī.)
ja322:2.1: beluvaṁ → veluvaṁ (sya-all) | patitaṁ → belalaṁ nipatita (bj: sīmu)
ja322:2.2: daddabhanti → dahakkanti (bj: sīmu) | duddubhanti → daddabhanti (cck: sī.)
